_readme: TOOLKIT — downloadable resources (one-pagers, fact sheets, hearing guides) for residents and stakeholders. This file is an ARRAY; the first element is this metadata object, remaining elements are toolkit rows. Row schema: {title, audience:'residents'|'STR-owners'|'HOAs'|'officials'|'press', summary, pdf (path under /assets or absolute URL)}. pdf paths below are PLACEHOLDERS — the referenced files do not exist yet; create and commit the PDFs (or swap to real URLs) before linking publicly, or the download will 404. TO EDIT: GitHub → PR → Vercel Preview → merge. Keep 'special assessment' language; never state per-property dollar figures; flag any unconfirmed claim '[UNVERIFIED]'.

toolkit.title: Stormwater plan: one-page overview
toolkit.summary: Plain-language summary of the flooding problem, the proposed dedicated special assessment (not a tax), and how the uniform-method timeline works. No per-property amounts.

toolkit.title: How to comment at a BCC hearing
toolkit.summary: Step-by-step guide to finding the agenda (mywaltonfl.gov), signing up to speak, and making an effective public comment on the stormwater assessment.
